experiment: E108 D1 recipe iteration (widened league BC + RL leg)
recipe: Board/scalar BC on 1511 demonstration files (346263 usable actions; 311428 training, 34835 validation). Selected epoch 10 of 14 at validation accuracy 0.8063. KL-anchored, return-weighted RL with adaptive beta, revert guard and search-bomb traces; learning rate 5e-5, initial beta 0.1, 300 rounds against two rule-based agents and Warden-v2. Selected RL episode 225.
metric_note: pooled_win and control win values are joint-top rates; warden_head_to_head.win is the strict pairwise outscore rate. These are historical E108 results.

history.decision: D1 recipe iteration promoted (pooled 6.650/0.681 vs 6.388/0.640); ship now beats warden_v2 head-to-head 5.853 vs 5.065 (was -0.73 behind at E88)

notes: Historical E108 CPU battery: 1120 rounds per model against a same-session control. Later inference changes retained these weights. The final report-stage ablation found no demonstrated score gain over the D1 BC checkpoint.
